1. Go to GitHub to download the corresponding Lyricon provider
2. Enable HyperLyric and the provider in LSPosed
3. Turn on the Super Island switch on the HyperLyric home page
4. Add music app package names in the whitelist page
5. Restart System UI and music apps
Reads MediaSession metadata output by the music app and displays lyrics through real-time or Xiaomi focus notifications.
Focus notifications may be restricted by a system allowlist; HyperLyric provides an allowlist bypass.

1. Turn on Notification Dynamic Island Lyrics in the HyperLyric app
2. Grant notification listener and post notification permissions, then add the music app to the lyric whitelist
3. Make the music app output lyric metadata; the car Bluetooth lyrics feature is only one possible method, and not every app requires that feature or a Bluetooth connection
4. If the system restricts HyperLyric in the background, grant autostart or background-running permission

Only supports HyperOS 3 devices with LSPosed v2.0+ installed

① Enable HyperLyric in LSPosed, then turn on "Xiaomi HyperIsland Lyrics" in the app
② Select a lyric source and install and enable its required dependencies
③ Select the music app in LSPosed
④ Restart SystemUI, the phone, or the music app as required by the source

HyperLyric 6.0 and later requires Lyricon Central and the LyricProvider for your music app. Enable the related modules, then restart SystemUI and the music app. If lyrics are missing, first check source and music-app version compatibility, then check that the required restart was completed.

Install and enable SuperLyric only. Restart the phone after first injection. SuperLyric does not support \"Show Next Lyric Line\". If lyrics are missing, first check that it sent lyrics to the music app and that the versions are compatible.

LyricInfo is recommended because mainstream music apps usually do not output lyric metadata. It writes lyrics into system MediaSession metadata; skip it only when the music app provides that metadata itself.
